limitations: Headless packet tests do not render or automate the Bedrock inventory UI.
Retail inventory drag restrictions and held-item appearance require a retail client test.
HUD JSON UI is not rendered by bedrock-protocol; the native icon renderer, layout and cached title data need retail-client confirmation.
NBT-specific HUD appearances, such as banner patterns, map content and dyed colors, are not transported by this version.
